title: AI answer charging and pay-online-when-joining are listed as switched off, but both switches are on live
what: The feature list marks two gym server features as waiting behind a switch: members' and page visitors' AI answers being taken from the gym's AI credits, and paying online on the join page. Both switches are on in the code on main and in the live answer read on 26 Nov, and the database parts are live. So both features are working for real gyms today while the map says they are held. One code note beside the join payment switch still says it is off for the owner's hold.
expected: A feature whose switch is on, with its database part live, is listed as live, and the note beside its switch says what it really is.
how_often: every time someone reads the feature list
fix_line: Mark both features live in the feature list and correct the switch note
